vscodeExtensions.title: PyClean
vscodeExtensions.description: A VS Code extension to refactor, clean, and format Python code following PEP 8 guidelines. Features AI-powered refactoring capabilities using Gemini.

vscodeExtensions.title: Invisible Mark
vscodeExtensions.description: A VS Code extension that enables zero-width character-based invisible watermarking and metadata embedding inside code files for source protection.

vscodeExtensions.title: CipherBox
vscodeExtensions.description: A secure editor extension to encrypt and decrypt sensitive files, configuration details, and credentials directly inside VS Code environments.

applications.title: system-design (PyPI Package)
applications.description: An open-source Python package and CLI tool on PyPI that automates folder layouts, generates design patterns boilerplate, and creates architectural diagrams.

applications.title: Elysian Modelling
applications.description: Interactive browser neural network sandbox visualizer. Create, edit, and train feedforward neural networks live in the browser with visual node weight paths.

applications.title: Flight Reservation System
applications.description: A database-driven reservation application in Python, utilizing object-oriented principles, modular architecture, and flight booking transaction modeling.

applications.title: FRI Data Project
applications.description: Data analysis and statistical modeling pipeline utilizing Python to analyze, visualize, and extract structural patterns from complex experimental datasets.
